What I wrote, and where I was

    How to read this page

    Everything shares one time axis — tape, scale, VO₂max — with the races, the milestone runs and the writing marked underneath.

    Waist is the primary fat-loss signal; weight is secondary. Weight is the fasted-morning daily minimum, aggregated to whole weeks — no timestamps, no per-reading rows.

    A line breaks where the measuring stopped, and nothing is drawn across the gap. The hatched stretches are real holes in the record rather than flat periods. Three of those breaks run longer than six months, and nothing in the data says why — those are notes still to be written.

    Uncertain tape readings are hollow. Which way an ambiguous digit fell was never recorded, so no error bar is drawn — an invented band would be half guesswork.
